mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openbanking_link ( user_id, access_token, refresh_token, fintech_use_num, bank_code, account_id, account_num_masked, expires_at, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{accessToken}, #{refreshToken}, #{fintechUseNum}, #{bankCode}, #{accountId}, #{accountNumMasked}, #{expiresAt}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT link_id, user_id, access_token, refresh_token, fintech_use_num, bank_code, account_id, account_num_masked, expires_at, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM openbanking_link WHERE fintech_use_num = #{fintechUseNum} AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1
